title: Surpanakha's entry into legend
introduction: Shuurpanakha, the problem demoness of Ramayana enters here. She approaches the cottage of Rama and offers her wifehood to Rama. She is the sister of Ravana and her husband Vidyut Jihva was murdered by Ravana alone, rendering his own sister a widow. She being an age-old demoness wants Rama to marry her, leaving Seetha off.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 17th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
कृत अभिषेको रामः तु सीता सौमित्रिर् एव च |
तस्मात् गोदावरी तीरात् ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आश्रमम्
verses.iast:
kṛta abhiṣeko rāmaḥ tu sītā saumitrir eva ca |
tasmāt godāvarī tīrāt tato jagmuḥ svam āśramam
verses.translation: On taking bath Rama with Seetha and Soumitri, then went to his own hermitage from that bank of River Godavari.

glosses.meaning: from that, Godavari, from bank, jagmuH svam aashramam = went, to his own, hermitage.

verses.devanagari:
आश्रमम् तम् उपागम्य राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः |
कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकम् कर्म पर्णशालाम् उपागमत्
verses.iast:
āśramam tam upāgamya rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ |
kṛtvā paurvāhṇikam karma parṇaśālām upāgamat
verses.translation: Nearing that hermitage Raghava along with Lakshmana performed early morning rituals and then reached the cottage.

verses.devanagari:
उवास सुखितः तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षभः|
स रामः पर्ण शालायाम् आसीनः सह सीतया
विरराज महा बाहुः चित्रया चन्द्रमा इव |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः
verses.iast:
uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra pūjyamāno maharṣabhaḥ |
sa rāmaḥ parṇa śālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā || 3-
virarāja mahā bāhuḥ citrayā candramā iva |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ
verses.translation: There Rama comfortably spent time while being adored by eminent sages when he is with them, and narrating many a narrative while sitting in hermitage along with Seetha and his brother Lakshmana, thus he shone forth like the moon when with Chitra constellation. [3-1-7-3, 4]
notes: The Chitra star is with clearest whiteness against the sky-blue background and thus it is said citra mauktikam ekam 'Chitra star and a pearl are one in colour.' Thus sky-blue coloured Rama is the moon while pearl white Seetha is pearl white Chitra star.

glosses.meaning: by eminent sages, being adored [when within their reach]
there, comfortably, stayed ï¿½ he who is spending time
in hermitage, Seetha, along with, sitting

verses.devanagari:
तदा आसीनस्य रामस्य कथा संसक्त चेतसः |
तम् देशम् राक्षसी काचिद् आजगाम यदृच्छ्हया
verses.iast:
tadā āsīnasya rāmasya kathā saṃsak{}ta cetasaḥ |
tam deśam rākṣasī kācid ājagāma yadṛcchhayā
verses.translation: At one time when Rama is sitting in hermitage and heartily absorbed in telling narratives some demoness arrived at that place, fortuitously.

glosses.meaning: Rama is, narrative, absorbed in, with such a heart

verses.devanagari:
सा तु शूर्पणखा नाम दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः |
भगिनी रामम् आसाद्य ददर्श त्रिदश उपमम्
verses.iast:
sā tu śūrpaṇakhā nāma daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ |
bhaginī rāmam āsādya dadarśa tridaśa upamam
verses.translation: She is but the sister of ten-faced demon Ravana, Shuurpanakha by her name and she has seen him on reaching the paradisiacal being like Rama.

verses.devanagari:
दीप्तास्यम् च महाबाहुम् पद्म पत्रायत ईक्षणम् |
गज विक्रांत गमनम् जटा मण्दल धारिणम्
सुकुमारम् महा सत्त्वम् पार्थिव व्यंजन अन्वितम् |
रामम् इन्दीवर श्यामम् कन्दर्प सदृश प्रभम्
बभूव इन्द्रोपमम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काम मोहिता |
verses.iast:
dīptāsyam ca mahābāhum padma patrāyata īkṣaṇam |
gaja vikrāṃta gamanam jaṭā maṇdala dhāriṇam
sukumāram mahā sattvam pārthiva vyaṃjana anvitam |
rāmam indīvara śyāmam kandarpa sadṛśa prabham
babhūva indropamam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasī kāma mohitā |
verses.translation: He whose face is radiant, arms lengthy, eyes large like lotus petals, stride like that of an elephant, wearing bunches of hair-tufts, delicate yet greatly vigorous, possessor of all kingly aspects, complexion deep-blue like blue lotus, similar to Love-god in brilliance and in simile to Indra, the demoness has seen such a Rama and became lovesick.

glosses.meaning: elephant, in pacing, in walk [imposingly pacing]

verses.devanagari:
सुमुखम् दुर्मुखी रामम् वृत्त मध्यम् महोदरी
विशालाक्षम् विरूपाक्षी सुकेशम् ताम्र मूर्धजा |
प्रियरूपम् विरूपा सा सुस्वरम् भैरव स्वना
तरुणम् दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणम् वाम भाषिणी |
न्याय वृत्तम् सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियम् अप्रिय दर्शना
शरीरज समाविष्टा राक्षसी रामम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
sumukham durmukhī rāmam vṛtta madhyam mahodarī
viśālākṣam virūpākṣī sukeśam tāmra mūrdhajā |
priyarūpam virūpā sā susvaram bhairava svanā
taruṇam dāruṇā vṛddhā dakṣiṇam vāma bhāṣiṇī |
nyāya vṛttam sudurvṛttā priyam apriya darśanā
śarīraja samāviṣṭā rākṣasī rāmam abravīt |
verses.translation: She that demoness who is facially unpleasant one with that pleasant faced one, pot bellied one with the slim-waisted one, wry-eyed one with the broad-eyed one, coppery-haired one with the neatly tressed one, ugly featured one with the charming featured one, brassy voiced one with the gentle voiced one, deplorably oldish one with the youngish one, crooked talker with the pleasant talker, ill-mannered one with the well-mannered one, uncouth one with couth, abominable one with amiable Rama spoke, besieged by Love-god.

glosses.meaning: un, pleasant one, to look at [abominable one - Shuurpanakha]
with pleasant one [to look on, amiable one - Rama]

verses.devanagari:
जटी तापस रूपेण सभार्यः शर चाप धृक्
आगतः त्वम् इमम् देशम् कथम् राक्षस सेवितम् |
किम् आगमन कृत्यम् ते तत् त्वम् आख्यातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa sabhāryaḥ śara cāpa dhṛk
āgataḥ tvam imam deśam katham rākṣasa sevitam |
kim āgamana kṛtyam te tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi
verses.translation: "You are an ascetic yet with a wife, handling bow and arrows yet in the appearance of a sageï¿½ what for you have come to this province frequented by demonsï¿½ it will be apt of you to tell the purpose of your coming here, in actualityï¿½"

glosses.meaning: your, coming [here,] purpose of, what is

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु राक्षस्या शूर्पणख्या परंतपः |
ऋजु बुद्धितया सर्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
evam uk{}taḥ tu rākṣasyā śūrpaṇakhyā parantapaḥ |
ṛju buddhitayā sarvam ākhyātum upacakrame
verses.translation: Thus asked by demoness Shuurpanakha that enemy-scorcher Rama started to inform all about it, straightforwardly.

glosses.meaning: all of it, to narrate [inform,] started to.

verses.devanagari:
आसीत् दशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदश विक्रमः |
तस्य अहम् अग्रजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः
verses.iast:
āsīt daśaratho nāma rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ |
tasya aham agrajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ
verses.translation: "A king named Dasharatha was there with his godlike valour, I am his eldest son, and people hear of me by name Rama.

glosses.meaning: Rama, by name, by people, heard.

verses.devanagari:
भ्राता अयम् लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान् माम् अनुव्रतः |
इयम् भार्या च वैदेही मम सीतेति विश्रुता
verses.iast:
bhrātā ayam lakṣmaṇo nāma yavīyān mām anuvrataḥ |
iyam bhāryā ca vaidehī mama sīteti viśrutā
verses.translation: "He is Lakshmana by his name, my younger brother and a devoted follower of mine, and she is my wife, daughter of Videha's king, well-known as Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
नियोगात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य पितुर् मातुः च यंत्रितः |
धर्मार्थम् धर्मकांक्षी च वनम् वस्तुम् इह आगतः
verses.iast:
niyogāt tu narendrasya pitur mātuḥ ca yaṃtritaḥ |
dharmārtham dharmakāṃkṣī ca vanam vastum iha āgataḥ
verses.translation: "Desiring to implement the probity in following father's orders and for the sake of establishing probity in living an ascetic's life I have come here to forests to dwell, as enjoined by the directives of the king and my father, and by my mother, as well.

glosses.meaning: probity, for the sake of, also
here, to live, to forests, I came.

verses.devanagari:
त्वाम् तु वेदितुम् इच्छ्हामि कस्य त्वम् का असि कस्य वा |
त्वम् हि तावन्मनोज्ञा.ंगी राक्षसी प्रतिभासि मे
verses.iast:
tvām tu veditum icchhāmi kasya tvam kā asi kasya vā |
tvam hi tāvanmanojñā.ṃgī rākśasī pratibhāsi me
verses.translation: "I too wish to know about you. Whose wife are you? What is your name? Or, whose daughter are you? By the way, you are with a most enthralling personality, and then you must be a demoness.
notes: So far the handsomeness of Shuurpanakha is not narrated in these verses. But Rama's addressing her as a handsome woman is for fun sake, so some commentators say. The episode Shuurpanakha is considered to have hāsya rasa, comic relief. Refusing the unnecessarily joking of Rama some say that Shuurpanakha came there with an exquisite form. And what all said negatively about her in preceding verses is the implicit idea of the poet. Taking the entrance of Shuurpanakha with a beautiful personality every cinema that is shot on Ramayana gives a cabaret dance with inciting song to Shuurpanakha at this situation.

In some other mms there are a few more verses that contain a situation where Jatayu comes to Rama to take leave of him to go and see his relatives and bird-friends, after Rama returns from the river. Then, knowing that Jatayu is not there Shuurpanakha enters the cottage area with a guise of winsome beauty. No demon or demoness can approach that cottage of Rama, as long as Jatayu is there - is the point for establishment. While the difference in mms/texts is between one or two letters like, na hi tāvat manojña angī and tvam hi tāvat manojña angī , whether the poet entered Shuurpanakha in a fashionable getup or as an old female is another point that remained inconclusive.

glosses.meaning: you, to know, I wish to
demoness, you are appearing, to me, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
इह वा किम् निमित्तम् त्वम् आगता ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः |
सा अब्रवीत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदन अर्दिता
verses.iast:
iha vā kim nimittam tvam āgatā brūhi tattvataḥ |
sā abravīt vacanam śrutvā rākṣasī madana arditā
verses.translation: "What for you have come, either, you tell in actuality..." Thus Rama asked her. On hearing the words of Rama she that demoness wetted with love said these words.

glosses.itrans: iha kim nimittam tvam aagataa vaa
glosses.iast: iha kim nimittam tvam āgatā vā
glosses.devanagari: इह किं निमित्तं त्वं आगता वा
glosses.meaning: here, what, for, you, came, either

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयताम् राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थम् वचनम् मम |
अहम् शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी
अरण्यम् विचरामि इदम् एका सर्व भयंकरा |
verses.iast:
śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārtham vacanam mama |
aham śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī
araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṅkarā |
verses.translation: "I will tell you truth, Rama, nothing but truth, I am a guise-changing demoness named Shuurpanakha, and I will be freely moving in this forest in a solitary manner and unnerving all.

glosses.meaning: truth, meaning, my. words [my words are truthful]
in this, forest, am freely moving.

verses.devanagari:
रावणो नाम मे भ्राता यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः
वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
vīro viśravasaḥ putro yadi te śrotram āgataḥ |
verses.translation: "My brother is valorous and mighty Ravana, the king of demons and the son of Vishravasa, if ever you have heard of him.

glosses.meaning: if ever, by you, to ears, has come [if ever you have heard of him]
If you ever heard, [or, mighty one, demons, king.]

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृद्ध निद्रः च सदा कुंभकर्णो महाबलः
विभीषणः तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षस चेष्टितः |
प्रख्यात वीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खर दूषणौ
verses.iast:
pravṛddha nidraḥ ca sadā kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasa ceṣṭitaḥ |
prakhyāta vīryau ca raṇe bhrātarau khara dūṣaṇau
verses.translation: "And the mighty Kumbhakarna who will always be in profound sleep is my brother, and the virtue-souled Vibheeshana too is my brother, but he does not behave like a demon, and two more bothers of mine are Khara and Duushana who are renowned for their bravery in war. [3-17-22b, 23

glosses.meaning: virtue-souled one, Vibheeshana [is also my brother]
Khara, Dushana[ bhraatarau = are two brothers.

verses.devanagari:
तान् अहम् समतिक्रान्ता राम त्वा पूर्व दर्शनात् |
समुपेता अस्मि भावेन भर्तारम् पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tān aham samatikrāntā rāma tvā pūrva darśanāt |
samupetā asmi bhāvena bhartāram puruṣottamam
verses.translation: "I can excel all of them by my bravery, oh, Rama, and on seeing you for the first time I had a notion that you being the choicest among men you alone are my husband, hence I neared you.

glosses.meaning: I an excel [them with my bravery]
as husband, with the notion of

verses.devanagari:
अहम् प्रभाव संपन्ना स्वच्छ्हंद बल गामिनी |
चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किम् करिष्यसि
verses.iast:
aham prabhāva sampannā svacchhaṃda bala gāminī |
cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi
verses.translation: "I am endowed with such preponderances and I can operate with my independent might, as such you become my everlasting husbandï¿½ by the way, what can you bring off with Seetha.

glosses.meaning: for a long time, to me, husband
with Seetha, what, you do [bring off.]

verses.devanagari:
विकृता च विरूपा च न सा इयम् सदृशी तव |
अहम् एव अनुरूपा ते भार्या रूपेण पश्य माम्
verses.iast:
vikṛtā ca virūpā ca na sā iyam sadṛśī tava |
aham eva anurūpā te bhāryā rūpeṇa paśya mām
verses.translation: "Unlovely and unshapely is this one, such as she is, this Seetha is unworthy to be your wife, and I am the lone one worthy to be your wife, hence treat me as your wife.

glosses.meaning: she, this one [such as she is]
to you , I, alone, appropriate [worthy wife]
me, wife, in manner of, see, me [treat me as your wife.]

verses.devanagari:
इमाम् विरूपाम् असतीम् करालाम् निर्णत उदरीम् |
अनेन सह ते भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम्
verses.iast:
imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm |
anena saha te bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm
verses.translation: "Shall I eat up this disfigured, dishonest, diabolical human female with a hallow stomach along with him, that brother of yours to make you free.
notes: Lakshmana will use the very same wording in the next chapter when retorting Shuurpanakha.

glosses.meaning: I wish to eat up [shall I eat them up without a later time botheration to you.]

verses.devanagari:
ततः पर्वत शृ.ंगाणि वनानि विविधानि च |
पश्यन्सहमयाकामीदण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि - यद्वा -
पश्यन् सह मया कामी दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि
verses.iast:
tataḥ parvata śṛ.ṃgāṇi vanāni vividhāni ca |
paśyansahamayākāmīdaṇḍakānvicariṣyasi - yadvā -
paśyan saha mayā kāmī daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi
verses.translation: "Afterwards, you can lustily ramble about Dandaka forest along with me while enjoying yourself on various mountaintops in the sky and in forests on the earth." So Shuurpanakha said to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् उक्तः काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिर ईक्षणाम् |
इदम् वचनम् आरेभे वक्तुम् वाक्य विशारदः
verses.iast:
iti evam uk{}taḥ kākutsthaḥ prahasya madira īkṣaṇām |
idam vacanam ārebhe vak{}tum vākya viśāradaḥ
verses.translation: When he is said that way Rama chuckled and that wordsmith started to reply her who eyes are besotted in lovesickness with this sentence.

glosses.meaning: thus, that way, who is said
one with besotted, eyes ï¿½ Shuurpanakha [in lovesickness]
